title: Minimal.
description: A build for optimization and minimal beauty in Minecraft
body:
# Minimal.

**If you have any problems with the build, you can write to my discord server and I will answer your problem.**

# About
Minimal build. This build is for those seeking the perfect balance of optimization and visual beauty in Minecraft. This lightweight build will run even on low-end PCs if you disable shaders. This is your ideal solution for a low-end PC.Besides optimization, this build includes some visual changes, as well as usability adjustments. Some mods (such as Flashback) can change the gameplay and this may be unfair on some servers, so I'm thinking of releasing a lightweight version of this build.

Please report build errors to my discord server.
Discord: https://discord.gg/mvuPPmj9
